escena: a university student on San Cristóbal sits at a wooden desk by a window, writes a large mystery mark on a sheet of cut paper with a thick pencil, face concentrated; beside the desk a small jar of soda bottle caps; a Galápagos finch watches from the window sill.

a shopkeeper at a small corner store in Puerto Baquerizo Moreno stares in disbelief at a delivery note while a crate of soda bottles floats upside down below the floor through a big hole in the wooden boards; the shelves behind are full; a sea lion peers into the hole.

five friends sit in a circle on a beach taking turns: one at a time wears a blindfold and tastes from an unmarked glass while the other four prepare the drinks; each person holds a small colored flag; a blue-footed booby acts as a judge on a rock.

a young woman pours water from a big jug into a tall glass that is already full, the water spilling gently over the rim onto a wooden pier; first small glasses in a row are filling fast and the last ones overflow; a marine iguana sips from the spilled puddle.

three nearly identical small taxi trucks parked side by side on a street of San Cristóbal, a mechanic with a clipboard scratches her head trying to tell them apart; a giant tortoise walks slowly past them; soft cut-paper clouds of exhaust.

a young woman flips a large cut-paper coin high in the air above a table with a map of small islands; some islands on the map have little radios placed on them and others do not; two colleagues watch the coin; a frigatebird overhead.

a student at home in a small bright room follows a video on a laptop while filling a notebook with a pencil, a mug and a plate of patacones beside her; through the window the harbor of San Cristóbal and a napping sea lion.
